title: bromus intermedius var. hughii
intro: Bromus intermedius var. hughii, commonly known as Hugh's bromegrass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. Research has shown that Hugh's bromegrass has various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the prevention of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Hugh's bromegrass include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Hugh's bromegrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
